name: Cost-aware acquisition escalation boundary
decision: KRN knowledge-acquisition candidates should expose a candidate-only low-to-high cost escalation path: review linked document evidence first when linkedDocumentEvidence exists, then source-search review, then bounded external research, and human review only when cheaper evidence remains insufficient. Missing-evidence-only candidates must start at source_search_review.
falsifier: A future acquisition candidate opens bounded external research, human review, autonomous acquisition, source truth mutation, or Memory Core mutation before exhausting cheaper linked-document or store-backed source-search review; or a missing-evidence-only candidate starts at linked_document_review.
doesNotProve: This retained pattern does not prove source truth, acquisition success, retrieval ranking quality, autonomous worker safety, Memory Core usefulness, or KRN product readiness.
